parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Section two. You will hear the director of a cooking school talking to a group of people about the different programs.

First, you have some time to look at questions eleven to sixteen on page three.

Now listen carefully and answer questions eleven to sixteen.

Welcome to the cooking school. I am Julie Brooks, head of programs. I'm here to give you information about the different tours and classes we offer as well as to show you our cooking facilities here. Our tours and classes are very popular. The most popular cooking tour is in the early summer in Northern California, which is famous for its cheeses. This four-day tour is special because each student receives one-on-one classes with a master chef. Then you'll take part in visits to the great cheese producers of the region, and you'll taste cheeses and see how they are made.

If you're looking to take a really adventurous vacation, take one of our cooking vacations in Italy and learn the passion of the Italian kitchen and have fun doing it. This cooking vacation takes place in a historic villa. There will be time to relax and enjoy the surroundings or to do some sightseeing in the area.

On the second day, a bus excursion is organized, leaving after lunch with visits to a salami factory and an olive oil mill, returning to the villa in time for dinner. On the third day, you go to the market, then cook your own dinner with a range of local ingredients.

One of the school's most popular tours is to the famous US city of New Orleans. This is a three-day tour where you will be staying in a hotel near the city's famous French Quarter. You'll have time to explore on your own before taking a unique city tour on foot led by a local chef.

Every afternoon, there's a cooking class for the group at your hotel's professional kitchen.

If you'd rather not spend the time to travel, we offer one-day cooking classes here at the school's state-of-the-art kitchen taught by our very talented chefs.

In the Budget Feasts class, you will learn how to make great-tasting meals that don't have to break your budget or require a lot of preparation time. For big families, this helps a lot. Many couples take our Cooking for Two class when their children go off to college. We teach how to make meals that are nutritious and elegant. They're even a bit romantic.

In the class called Variations on a Theme, you learn to cook a variety of dishes using a specific ingredient in each. For example, in the next class, you will prepare meals using lemon. The lemon chicken meal is divine.

Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions seventeen to twenty on page four.

Now listen and answer questions seventeen to twenty.

I'd like to give you a tour of our beautiful kitchen where the meals are made. Our one-day classes meet here. Just walk through the entrance. Right. Now, you can see the large preparation table in the middle of the main kitchen. This beautiful table is large enough for twelve students to work on.

This room also has a state-of-the-art oven. It's large enough for up to twenty-five cakes. It's just past the preparation table on the left near the entrance to the hallway. Perishable items are kept in this industrial-sized refrigerator next to the storage in the hallway. We keep non-perishable items in the storage.

As you exit from the hallway, you'll come into the large demonstration kitchen. Here, we hold smaller classes, but mainly it's used for cooking demonstrations and tasting events.

The last thing I want to point out is our utensil cabinet. It sits right next to the exit. It contains a variety of cooking pots and pans and an amazing range of forks and spoons.

Please feel free to stay around the school to check out our very...

That is the end of section two. You now have half a minute to check your answers.

analyses.content: 录音里提到这个加州北部的课程特色是每个学生都能获得和大师级厨师一对一（one-on-one）的上课机会，对应选项C的“个人烹饪课程（individual cooking lessons）”。

The most popular cooking tour is in the early summer in Northern California, which is famous for its cheeses. This four-day tour is special because each student receives one-on-one classes with a master chef. Then you'll take part in visits to the great cheese producers of the region, and you'll taste cheeses and see how they are made.
你可能会因为一开始听到起司（cheeses）就去寻找做菜原料相关的选项，但原文只是在铺垫该地以起司闻名，重点特色其实是紧接着强调的一对一教学。

If you're looking to take a really adventurous vacation, take one of our cooking vacations in Italy and learn the passion of the Italian kitchen and have fun doing it. This cooking vacation takes place in a historic villa. There will be time to relax and enjoy the surroundings or to do some sightseeing in the area. On the second day, a bus excursion is organized, leaving after lunch with visits to a salami factory and an olive oil mill, returning to the villa in time for dinner.
你听到“historic villa（历史悠久的别墅）”可能想选B（了解食物历史），但“历史悠久”只是用来修饰住宿地点的，并没有提到会讲解食物的历史，属于经典的偷换概念。
录音中明确说到这个意大利行程在第二天午餐后会安排巴士出游（bus excursion），对应选项H的“下午的巴士之旅（afternoon bus tour）”。

One of the school's most popular tours is to the famous US city of New Orleans. This is a three-day tour where you will be staying in a hotel near the city's famous French Quarter. You'll have time to explore on your own before taking a unique city tour on foot led by a local chef.
这个题目很直白，只要不把“on foot（步行）”漏听，就能死死锁定选项F里的“walking”。
录音说到新奥尔良之旅会有一个由当地厨师带领的徒步城市观光（city tour on foot），完美对应选项F的“有导游带领的步行游览（guided walking tour）”。
In the Budget Feasts class, you will learn how to make great-tasting meals that don't have to break your budget or require a lot of preparation time. For big families, this helps a lot.
千万别只盯着“预算（Budget）”去找和便宜相关的选项，破题的关键是抓取到后面的“不需要大量准备时间”，也就是“time-saving”。
这个“预算盛宴”课程主打教你做不需要花大量准备时间（don't require a lot of preparation time）的饭菜，对应选项G的“省时的饭菜（time-saving meals）”。
Many couples take our Cooking For Two class when their children go off to college. We teach how to make meals that are nutritious and elegant. They're even a bit romantic.
你一听到“孩子们去上大学（children go off to college）”肯定特别想选D（为大学生做饭），但这门课其实是空巢父母为了自己学的，专门挖坑引诱你选错。
录音里说这个“两人烹饪”课程会教大家做营养丰富（nutritious）的餐点，对应选项E的“准备健康的饭菜（healthy meals）”。
这个课程名字叫“主题变奏”，核心在于教你每道菜都使用一种特定的食材（specific ingredient），对应选项A的“用某一种特定食材烹饪”。

In the class called Variations on a Theme, you learn to cook a variety of dishes using a specific ingredient in each. For example, in the next class, you will prepare meals using lemon. The lemon chicken meal is divine.
录音后面紧接着举了“柠檬”作为具体食材的例子，进一步确认了就是围绕单一材料来做菜，只要不把ingredient（食材）这个关键名词跟丢就不会错。

Now, you can see the large preparation table in the middle of the main kitchen. This beautiful table is large enough for twelve students to work on. This room also has a state-of-the-art oven. It's large enough for up to twenty-five cakes. It's just past the preparation table on the left, near the entrance to the hallway.
做地图题最怕找错参照物，这里你必须先跟上中间大桌子这个起点，然后顺着路线往左移，并且锁定“走廊入口（entrance to the hallway）”这个空间分割线索。
录音以中间的大型备菜桌（preparation table）为参照物，说烤箱（oven）就在备菜桌过去一点的左边，靠近走廊（hallway）入口处，对应地图上的位置H。
Perishable items are kept in this industrial-sized refrigerator next to the storage in the hallway. We keep non-perishable items in the storage.
这道题你可能会跟丢路线，关键是上一题的结尾已经把视线引到了走廊，这里顺着走廊看进去，听到“next to the storage”就能秒定答案。
录音接着说冰箱（refrigerator）位于走廊（hallway）里的储藏室（storage）旁边，对应地图上处于走廊内部区域的位置F。
As you exit from the hallway, you'll come into the large demonstration kitchen. Here we hold smaller classes, but mainly it's used for cooking demonstrations and tasting events.
这里考的是动态行进过程，千万别卡在走廊内部找不出来，听到“exit from the hallway”你的视线就要跟着移到下一个新的开阔区域。
路线提示说当你从走廊出来（exit from the hallway），就会进入大型演示厨房（demonstration kitchen），对应地图上走廊尽头外接的大空间D。
The last thing I want to point out is our utensil cabinet. It sits right next to the exit. It contains a variety of cooking pots and pans and an amazing range of forks and spoons.
此题非常直接也是救命题，即使你前面走丢了，听到“next to the exit”就能迅速看图找到出口标志定位，别被后面罗列的一堆锅碗瓢盆（pots, pans, forks, spoons）词汇干扰了判断。
最后提到餐具柜（utensil cabinet）就坐落在整个场地的出口（exit）紧挨着的位置，对应地图右上角出口旁边的B。
